translated: [CORNER: Song] With that, let's play a song.
So, this song features Shizuku as the lead, and I'd be happy if you could listen to it while feeling the way the weather in your heart changes along with the music.
[CORNER: Theme Mail] For this episode, we asked for mail on this theme:
"Things I'm looking forward to in autumn."
The late summer heat is still lingering, but autumn will be here before we know it.
So, we asked everyone to send in what they're looking forward to this fall.
Let's get right into the mail.
This is from Radio name: Agetate no Potato.
"What I'm looking forward to this autumn is the maple leaves."
"I'm going to Kyoto in September to see the autumn foliage."
"I usually go to Kyoto in the summer, so this is my first time going in the fall. After seeing photos of the colors at places like Kiyomizu-dera,
I thought they looked so beautiful, and I'm really excited to go see them for myself."
